name: Facet
text: Adopt a dark theme with high-contrast interactive elements for EXCAVA’s interface. This maximizes visibility in low-light environments and reduces eye strain during long sessions, aligning with our goal of clarity and enjoyment. The trade-off is that users accustomed to light themes may initially resist, but the toggle we’ll add mitigates this. High contrast also sharpens focus on data, making interactions livelier and faster to interpret.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes fail users with light sensitivity—this isn’t a niche edge case. A toggle adds cognitive load for users who just want one mode to work. The real risk is alienating users who need light themes, not just those who prefer them. Settle it with user testing: measure task completion time and error rates in both themes for light-sensitive and standard users.
